name: Changes
author: David Given; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
description: Elysia, a new Earth found by a starship on a thousand-year voyage, and you are not quite what you were. Text adventure in English (David Given, 2012). Type if-changes in the Terminal or tap the icon.
